question: Which of the following cities in India faces monsoon rain first?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thiruvananthapuram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Thiruvananthapuram** is the first city in India to receive monsoon rains.
 
• It is located in the southern state of Kerala, which is the entry point for the southwest monsoon in India.
